_note: All user-visible content lives here. Edit freely and restart; logic never depends on the wording. castsPerDay, rewardCapPerDay and walletTiers are the A/B knobs.

walletTiers._note: Rewards depend only on the user's current AstroLokal wallet balance (from the Redash sync), read once at the day's first roll — same tiers every day. A balance goes to the FIRST tier whose maxBalance it is <= (boundaries belong to the lower tier); the last tier has maxBalance null and catches everything above. rewards = the fixed [roll1, roll2, roll3] payout; 0 = Better luck.

coinCredit._note: Fields sent to the internal Coin API (server-side only). {day} in the description is replaced with the product day the redemption happened on.

nav._note: Webview keeps no browser history. The back arrow posts GO_BACK to the RN shell when available; otherwise it fires this deeplink (same one the Bhagya surfaces use).

copy._note: Keep every label in simple, everyday words (tier-2/3 audience).
